title: RUN INFO PANEL ON THE SHARED PALETTE
why: UI step 4, the HUD in play. The run info panel (conditions, contracts, goals) used five colours that are not in the style guide (#ffc04a, #c9b27a, #cdd6dd, #8a96a1, #7fc4a0). It now reads the shared UIC table: the accent for headings, tx_1 for contract and goal rows, tx_2 for the chevron, ok and danger for notes. Same text, same layout, same count of contracts (his v6.79).
now: Run info panel uses the same colors as the menus.

edits.replacement: rows.push({k:'CONTRACTS',v:'',c:UIC.acc});   // v28.xx (cw-runinfopal), UI step 4 (style guide: one palette): the run info panel used five off-palette colours (#ffc04a, #c9b27a, #cdd6dd, #8a96a1, #7fc4a0); it now reads UIC: accent headings, tx_1 rows, tx_2 chevron, ok and danger for notes.
